Which do you like better,
baseball or football?{be01}

Ami: The game ended
before I knew what was going on.{be01}
Eira: The combination play of you
and your Pokémon is great!

What? You have only one
Pokémon that can fight?

We are always together!
Our combination play must be great!{be01}

healthy Pokémon...?
